G2500.b:

G2505.b:

(for καθ’ ἅ), [in LXX: ⟦Genesis 7:9|Ge 7:9⟧ ⟦Genesis 19:8|19:8⟧, al. (⁨כַּאֲשֶׁר⁩, ⁨כְּ⁩), ⟦Isaiah 58:11|Is 58:11⟧, Wi 3:10, al. ;] ⟪just as⟫, ⟪according as⟫: ⟦Matthew 27:10|Mt 27:10⟧(LXX), ⟦Luke 1:2|Lk 1:2⟧, D (cf. Bl., § 78, 1; Phil. Gosp., 8 f.).†

G2506.b:
⟪καθ-αίρεσις⟫, -εως, ἡ

⟪2.⟫ ⟪to put down by force⟫, ⟪pull down⟫, ⟪destroy⟫: ἀποθήκας, ⟦Luke 12:18|Lk 12:18⟧ (opp. to οἰκοδομεῖν); δυνάστας, ⟦Luke 1:52|Lk 1:52⟧; ἔθνη, ⟦Acts 13:19|Ac 13:19⟧; pass., ⟦Acts 19:27|Ac 19:27⟧ (diminished, Field, Notes, 129 f.); fig., ⟪to refute⟫: λογισμούς, ⟦2 Corinthians 10:5|II Co 10:5⟧.†

⟪1.⟫ In physical sense: c. acc. rei, fig., ⟦Matthew 23:25|Mt 23:25⟧, ⟦Matthew 23:26|26⟧, ⟦Luke 11:39|Lk 11:39⟧; of disease (leprosy), c. acc. pers., ⟦Matthew 8:2|Mt 8:2⟧, ⟦Matthew 8:3|3⟧ ⟦Matthew 10:8|10:8⟧ ⟦Matthew 11:5|11:5⟧, ⟦Mark 1:40|Mk 1:40-42⟧, ⟦Luke 4:27|Lk 4:27⟧ ⟦Luke 5:12|5:12⟧, ⟦Luke 5:13|13⟧ ⟦Luke 7:22|7:22⟧ ⟦Luke 17:14|17:14⟧, ⟦Luke 17:17|17⟧; ἡ λέπρα ἐκαθερίσθη (on the spelling v. supr.), ⟦Matthew 8:3|Mt 8:3⟧.

(rei), seq. ἀπό (Bl., § 36, 9; Deiss., BS, 216 f.), ⟦2 Corinthians 7:1|II Co 7:1⟧, ⟦Hebrews 9:14|He 9:14⟧, ⟦1 John 1:7|I Jo 1:7⟧, ⟦1 John 1:9|9⟧.

G2512.b:

(< καθαρίζω), [in LXX for ⁨טֳהָר⁩, ⁨טׇהֳרָה⁩, etc.;] ⟪cleansing⟫, ⟪purification⟫: ⟦John 3:25|Jo 3:25⟧; c. gen. subjc., τ Ἰουδαίων, ⟦John 2:6|Jo 2:6⟧; c. gen. obj., of women after childbirth, ⟦Luke 2:22|Lk 2:22⟧; of lepers, ⟦Mark 1:44|Mk 1:44⟧, ⟦Luke 5:14|Lk 5:14⟧; c. gen. rei, τ. ἁμαρτιῶν, ⟦Hebrews 1:3|He 1:3⟧, ⟦2 Peter 1:9|II Pe 1:9⟧ (Cremer, 319).†
